rules.message: The 5.0L V8 requires the 10-Speed Automatic because of its torque output.
The EV Dual Motor drivetrain only works with the Single-Speed Direct unit.
The Single-Speed Direct unit is only available with the EV Dual Motor.
Logging needs extreme torque. The Ford F-350 with the 5.0L V8 is the recommended setup for rugged terrain.
Urban delivery fleets in California should use the EV Dual Motor to meet local emission targets.
Long-haul delivery benefits from the 10-Speed Automatic for highway efficiency and driver fatigue.
The Sport trim pairs best with Performance Wheels and Upgraded Brakes.
The 5.0L V8 is reserved for the Super Duty F-350 chassis.
The Ford F-350 is not offered with the 2.0L I4 Turbo.
The Ford F-350 is not offered with the EV Dual Motor.
The RAM 2500 is not offered with the 2.0L I4 Turbo.
The RAM 2500 is not offered with the EV Dual Motor.
The 1500-series chassis is not rated for the 5.0L V8 package.
